items.information: The registration is free, maximum number of competitors is 130. Please give us as soon as possible the exact number of guests coming with you **and their names.** There is a restriction on the registration to the following events, you can only chose 3 out of these 6 events : - 6x6 cube; - 7x7 cube; - Rubik's Clock; - 4x4 blindfolded; - 5x5 blindfolded, - 3x3 multiple blindfolded. If you register for more than 3 of these events, your registration may be deleted if you don't answer us. Due to venue restriction we expect the maximum number of competitors to be reached. If this number is reached, and since the competition is free, we will ask you to confirm your registration some weeks before the competition. If you don't answer this email your registration may be deleted. Please register only if you are sure to come: keep in mind that not showing up to the competition may prevent someone else from competing!

items.information: Tunisia Autumn Open 2016 is open for participants from all countries, everyone is welcome. To get to the venue, you can either take the train up to "Les Hotels" stop, it's a 20 minute walk from that station. You can take the bus, number 52A from the central station in Monastir or Sousse. This bus stops just in front of the hotel. You can go by car, follow the highway linking Monastir and Sousse. It should be known that only competitors who do check-in into the hotel can benefit from the lunch. Medals and Gifts will be awarded to the winners in each category. Competition fee is 10dt per participant
